system.description: You have a large, bony shell that is fused to your spine. This shell may be smooth or covered in spines or even strikingly patterned, though its coloration typically matches that of your scales. Because of this, you cannot wear armor made for most humanoids, though you may use shields if you are proficient and benefit from magic items that raise your AC. Your shell is still hard and thick, however, and provides you some measure of protection. Your AC is equal to 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier.
